entries: Jokes, at a time like this?
不管那是什么，我们赢了。
Peace at last. That nagging voice is finally gone.
终于平静了。那个聒噪的声音总算消失了。
The crystal remains intact. I wonder who it is in there.
水晶依然完好。我好奇里面是谁。
I no longer hear that name in the air.
空气中再也听不到那个名字了。
I wish I could say the same...
So many creature with no bone. Strange world.
这么多没骨头的生物。奇怪的世界。
It is times like this that levity can raise one's spirits when all else fails. Perhaps a song then?
正是这种时候，当一切都不管用了，一点轻快还能提提精神。那么，来首歌？
Perhaps we are victorious, but that rift did not come from that creature. Quite the other way I am afraid.
也许我们胜利了，可那道裂隙并非来自那个生物。恐怕恰恰相反。
